title: Message Envelope
description: Standard envelope wrapping every message between runtime and game.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the message was created.

session_id.description: Session identifier assigned during handshake. Present on all messages after handshake.

in_reply_to.description: When this message is a response, the ID of the request message.

payload.description: Message-type-specific payload. Schema depends on 'type' field.
